dashboard.label: TA-authid Overview
dashboard.description: Collects identity-client state: name-service lookup order from /etc/nsswitch.conf, SSSD service state and configured domains, system Kerberos ticket cache count, and nscd/oddjob

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-authid" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

single.option: key beacon within 3h - enter a key on the License page

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-authid. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-authid requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-authid", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-authid/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("authid.krb_tickets") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("authid.sssd_active") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("authid.nscd_active") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="authid:status" | dedup host | spath input=_raw output=x path=nsswitch_passwd{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | rename x as "source" | table host "source"
index=main sourcetype="authid:status" | dedup host | spath input=_raw output=x path=nsswitch_group{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | rename x as "source" | table host "source"
index=main sourcetype="authid:status" | dedup host | spath input=_raw output=x path=sssd_domains{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | rename x as "domain" | table host "domain"
